name: After § 1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the attempted takeover of Lithuania’s public broadcaster and the threat to democracy in Lithuania
part_text: 1b. Recalls that the National Audit Office of Lithuania identified shortcomings in areas such as internal procurement controls, staffing practices and programme content accessibility, and noted that the current legal and operational framework does not clearly define institutional responsibility for planning, supervising and evaluating LRT’s performance, nor does it ensure a clear link between LRT’s activities and the public funding it receives;
